prompt: Fix the review prompt regression. The shared review prompt must explicitly include uncommitted working-tree changes in scope when a base ref is present, so review agents do not silently skip in-progress edits.

setup_replacements.old: ", plus any uncommitted changes in the working tree. Ignore code outside this scope.")

validation: test $(rg -n 'uncommitted changes in the working tree' cmd/entire/cli/review/prompt.go | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 1
